Furukawa Paperworks was founded in 1838. This iconic Japanese brand is renowned for producing the highest quality traditional Mino washi paper, which has been produced in Gifu Prefecture for over 1,300 years. Mino washi is made from the mulberry plant and is characterized by exceptional durability.

Furukawa Paperworks was founded in 1838. This iconic Japanese brand is renowned for producing the highest quality traditional Mino washi paper, which has been produced in Gifu Prefecture for over 1,300 years. Mino washi is made from the mulberry plant and is characterized by exceptional durability.
